hard_constraints: Do not deploy a card absent from hand
Do not spend more elixir than observed available
Do not assume unseen enemy cards are known
Do not use ground-only units as direct air defenders
Do not infer opponent exact elixir from visual evidence alone
No direct damage spell exists in deck
operating_modes: triple_elixir: high tempo but protect critical defense
overtime: prioritize tower-health race and lethal threats
bait_logic: Track cards played since spell; do not assume precise rotation with unknown special mechanics
Pressure with Goblin Barrel when expected answer is weak and defense budget sufficient
Use Wall Breakers to force split resource allocation
positioning: Store calibrated tile coordinates for each screen resolution
Validate Cannon center pull by unit type
Avoid deploying Princess and Dart Goblin inside the same spell radius
Re-observe after deployment before queuing a new action
